How the optimiser works
Every line is priced with its best valid coupon, then shipping is added once per shop and free-shipping thresholds are applied to the shop subtotal. A shop only qualifies as a single-shop option when it stocks every line and delivers to your country. Split orders pay shipping per shop — the optimiser only recommends them when the total still wins.
